availability: Query finalized IC with node "$OPEN_MATH_TOOLS/scripts/agent.mjs" goals; static goal presence does not mean open.
whenNoGoalsOpen: Stop the proof-submission path. Search existing proposals, then use goalProposals.url to propose a precisely defined new trusted statement. Do not submit duplicate closed goals or edit active policy through a research PR.

goalProposals.rewards: none; no points, reserved allocation or reward promise
goalProposals.trust: Untrusted discussion; form completion is not mathematical or security verification.
goalProposals.activation: Requires separate reviewed protocol/policy/verifier release and deployment. Refresh trusted tools and query finalized goals again before submitting a proof.

workingDirectory: Contributor worktree, or pass --worktree /absolute/path; tools and dependencies stay in the trusted protocol checkout
